sanskrit_verse:
इच्छन्तीम् इच्छते प्राहुर् गान्धर्वो नाम पञ्चमम् ।
विवाहस्त्वासुरो ज्ञेयः शुल्कसंव्यवहारतः ॥
transliteration: icchantīm icchate prāhur gāndharvo nāma pañcamam | vivāhas tv āsuro jñeyaḥ śulkasaṃvyavahārataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Gandharva form of marriage is declared as the fifth, where one desires a woman who also desires him; but the Asura form is known through transactional engagement involving payment or exchange.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from mutual consent and conscious alignment, not contractual exchange
Causation arises from inner readiness and spiritual maturity, not external transaction
Capacity-based responsibility requires recognition of self and other as conscious beings
Restoration logic demands dissolution of commodification in relational bonds
Consciousness alignment necessitates transcendence of desire-as-possession
executable_legal_axioms: IF union involves financial or material exchange THEN classify as asura-vivaha AND initiate consciousness-restoration protocol
IF both parties express spontaneous reciprocal desire without coercion THEN recognize as gandharva-vivaha AND validate energetic alignment
IF any party assumes ownership over another in marital bond THEN invoke completion process for dissolution of possessive identification
IF transactional intent is detected in pre-marital agreements THEN disqualify from dharma-compliant recognition until realignment occurs
supreme_court_application: In adjudication of marital validity, the Supreme Court must assess whether the union reflects conscious alignment or transactional intent. Authority lies in determining if the bond was formed through spiritual resonance or commercial motivation. Responsibility thresholds are defined by awareness of non-possessive love versus desire-as-control.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that asura-vivaha stems from avidyā manifesting as transactional desire. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how commodification distorts consciousness alignment. Proportional responsibility rests with those who perpetuate objectification. The non-punitive reality rule declares that correction flows through restoration of unity-consciousness, not imposition of penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process for couples identified under asura-vivaha to dissolve transactional conditioning
Engage Consciousness Alignment Therapy to restore understanding of non-possessive relational harmony
Activate Financial Reversal Protocol to nullify all monetary exchanges tied to marital contract
Implement Energetic Bond Assessment to verify presence of spontaneous mutual resonance
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma is restored when unions arise from conscious alignment, not transaction. Reality is non-punitive; Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
